_note: Independent health food stores in and around Perth. One record per store. status: candidate = import as a draft once verified; manual = real and relevant but needs an editor; rejected = out of scope, with reason. Evidence is from each store's own website. Blurbs are our own summaries; no health claims. Unknown stays unknown. Personal phone numbers and emails were not collected.
